mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.total_amount, o.status, o.address_name, o.address_phone, o.address_detail, o.create_time, o.shipped_time, o.refunded_time, o.express_company, o.express_no, o.express_courier, o.express_status, o.received_time, o.confirmed_time, o.sender_name, o.sender_address, o.sender_phone, u.nickname as userNickname, u.avatar_url as userAvatar FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.total_amount, o.status, o.address_name, o.address_phone, o.address_detail, o.create_time, o.shipped_time, o.refunded_time, o.express_company, o.express_no, o.express_courier, o.express_status, o.received_time, o.confirmed_time, o.sender_name, o.sender_address, o.sender_phone, u.nickname as userNickname, u.avatar_url as userAvatar FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status = 'shipped', shipped_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `order` SET status = 'refunded', refunded_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) as orderQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) as orderAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as refundCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as completedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as completedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as refundedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as refundedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as pendingOrders FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) as orderAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as completedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as refundedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as refundedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as pendingCount FROM `order` o WHERE o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT oi.product_id as productId, oi.product_name as productName, SUM(oi.quantity) as salesQuantity, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as salesAmount FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.product_name ORDER BY salesQuantity DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.user_id, r.order_no, r.total_amount, r.reason, r.status, r.apply_time, r.review_time, r.reviewer_id, u.nickname as userNickname, u.avatar_url as userAvatar FROM order_refund r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.apply_time ASC

SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.user_id, r.order_no, r.total_amount, r.reason, r.status, r.apply_time, r.review_time, r.reviewer_id, u.nickname as userNickname, u.avatar_url as userAvatar FROM order_refund r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_refund SET status = #{status}, review_time = NOW(), reviewer_id = #{reviewerId} WHERE id = #{id}
